items.text: Breece Hall Q (quad) again with cryptic tweets and trade rumors; was close last week, Braelon Allen beneficiary if out.
items.why: Limited practices, cryptic social post, trade rumors.
items.implication: Game-time; lean out possible; monitor active/inactive closely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full Braelon Allen workload; if IN, shared but primary.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN (no designation) after ankle injury; expected to play with minor rushing docks possible.
items.why: Not on final injury report; full practices implied.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens pass catchers; small dock on rushing volume.
items.opportunity: Full starter snaps/routes for weapons; rushing slightly reduced.

items.text: Saquon Barkley IN (no final report designation) despite hamstring/back; playing but likely not 100%.
items.why: Shocked not on final report; hard to believe fully healthy.
items.implication: Start with caution; re-injury risk; PHI WR outs boost his checkdowns.
items.opportunity: Primary RB snaps/carries/RZ despite limits; Smith/Wicks OUT expand receiving.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot); taken out of projections with fallout noted.
items.implication: TB WR depth elevates; Godwin/others see more targets.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining TB WRs/RBs in passing game.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon clear/IN creates more opportunity in PHI offense.
items.implication: Elevates other PHI pass catchers and Barkley receiving work.
items.opportunity: Higher target/route share for remaining WRs/TEs; Barkley checkdowns.

items.text: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; multiple teams reached out, talks active/ongoing (per Schefter/Rapoport).
items.why: Sources confirm willingness and active discussions pre-Nov 10 deadline.
items.implication: Monitor landing spot for ROS value shift; IND depth chart impact if dealt.
items.opportunity: Potential new team role/volume; short-term IND uncertainty low.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee); unique role means no clean replacement but 3-6 extra targets available; Waddle also Q (chest).
items.implication: DEN target redistribution; Waddle Q compounds uncertainty.
items.opportunity: 3-6 more targets open; Waddle if active or other DEN WRs/RBs.

items.text: After two-TD outing, sell Quinshon Judkins; role hit with Dylan Sampson return (snap/target share lows).
items.why: Levitan explains post-2TD; Sampson return cuts target share significantly (from 13.6% avg without).
items.implication: Sell-high while value peaked; reduced receiving role ongoing.
items.opportunity: Majority touches remain but passing-game hit; lower ceiling.

items.text: AJ Brown taken OUT of projections (knee); also Q on board but treated as out for now with fallout.
items.implication: NE WR/TE target boost; Henderson also Q.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining NE pass catchers.

items.text: Josh Jacobs following Ashton Jeanty path: strong fantasy via high-value touches (3 inside-5 carries + 13 targets in 2 games post-suspension); efficiency bonus only.
items.why: High-value touches king; parallel to Jeanty inefficiency but volume.
items.implication: Reliable RB1/2 value on opportunity alone.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE; production lacking and Chiefs (matchup) allowed only one WR TD all year (to JSN).
items.why: Poor production + tough matchup (1 WR TD allowed season-long).
items.implication: Sit/fade even if active (also Q chest); low floor/ceiling.
items.opportunity: Limited targets/routes expected vs elite coverage.
items.conflict: Harvey OUT could open some targets if Waddle plays.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE/WR5 this week; Lamar expected back unlocks him fully.
items.why: Lamar return boosts entire offense; track-meet potential vs BUF.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; elevated targets/routes with Jackson.
items.opportunity: Full Lamar-driven target share and red-zone upside.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG in 2 games since Caleb Williams return; leads TE utilization, top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: 10 Facts: 30% share, utilization leader post-Williams return.
items.implication: Strong TE1 start; sustained role with Williams.

items.text: Brian Thomas Jr. fallen to Konata Mumpfield/Troy Franklin tier in Wk 8 projections after 87-1282-10 rookie year; 20 games later major drop.
items.why: Projection tier collapse; usage/efficiency issues implied.
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats; low upside currently.
items.opportunity: Reduced routes/targets relative to rookie breakout.
